decisions.title: Tenant isolation strategy
decisions.text: Shared DB + schoolId. Enforced centrally: authMiddleware derives tenant from the DB account, sanitises schoolId from body/query/params for non-superAdmin and runs the request inside an AsyncLocalStorage context; a global Mongoose plugin forces schoolId on every query/aggregate/create for schoolId-bearing models and blocks re-assigning schoolId in updates. SuperAdmin, public routes, cron and workers run without context (must scope explicitly). Queries must be awaited INSIDE the request handler (Mongoose queries are lazy).

decisions.title: Authentication strategy
decisions.text: Short-lived access JWT (15m, HS256, iss/aud, typ=access, sid) + 30d httpOnly refresh cookie. Server-side AuthSession per login; refresh rotates jti with atomic compare-and-swap; replay of an old jti revokes the session. Role/school are always read from the DB account, never from the token. Secrets are mandatory env vars (startup fails otherwise). Login brute-force lock per identifier.

decisions.title: Transactions
decisions.text: utils/txn.js withTxn(): real transaction on replica set/mongos (detected once via hello), otherwise runs fn(null) once with a warning; REQUIRE_TRANSACTIONS=true makes unsupported deployments fail. Never 'run then retry without txn' (could double-write). Idempotency does not rely on transactions: atomic status claim + unique sparse indexes (Payment.transactionRef, Invoice.dedupeKey).

decisions.title: Payment trust model
decisions.text: Browser/IPN payloads are never trusted. Success is recorded ONLY by paymentService.finalizeSuccess after gateway server-to-server verification (SSLCommerz validation API / bKash execute), amount+currency+tran_id compared to the server-side Transaction (copied from Invoice). Late fail/cancel can only change PENDING transactions. Money taken for an already-paid invoice is flagged 'invoice_already_paid' for manual reconciliation instead of double-crediting.

decisions.title: School deletion semantics
decisions.text: Hard cascade delete (as the existing UI implies) incl. financial records, auto-discovering schoolId models; no undo. Recommendation for production: add an 'archive' step / export before delete (NOT built).

decisions.title: RBAC model
decisions.text: authMiddleware(roles) stays as the coarse gate; config/permissions.js is the single policy catalogue and requirePermission(...) is the preferred way for NEW/changed routes (already used by fees+invoices). Ownership (own student / own class) via utils/ownership.js. tests/route-audit.test.js is the safety net: any new route without auth or off the allow-list fails CI; any role not listed gets 403 on every restricted route.
